rows.wireguard_scope: Optional structural header decode, not authentication. Message hashes join proxy hops without exporting encrypted content. Capture stop times differ: do not treat a later sender tail as loss at an already stopped receiver.
rows.scope: Fresh first-use observation only. Historical five packets cannot be reconstructed. See inner/outer capture and readback bounds before assigning any fault.
